forbidden_claims: Using off-event AOI weather, dNBR, annual image-change, or gridded precipitation values as local Greece evidence.
Claiming exact burned area from the formula beyond the report's EFFIS comparison statement.
required_claims: The event window is 2023-07-01 through 2023-08-31, giving 62 inclusive days.
The August 22 image offset ratio is 0.855 and the August 23 forecast offset ratio is 0.871.
The three process indices are 98.1, 97.8, and 97.4, with combined response priority 97.8.
The report explicitly supports direct damage because fires near Athens burned homes and cars.

reasoning_depth.counterfactual_rejection: A generic burn-scar or local-weather-index answer fails because the report directly supports smoke transport, Athens damage, fire clustering, and casualty signals.
reasoning_depth.evidence_weighting: NASA report text and event-anchor timing are decisive; off-event AOI weather, dNBR, gridded precipitation, and exposure products are not used in the scoring path.
reasoning_depth.uncertainty_or_scale_caveat: The formula summarizes reported process signals and should not be used as an exact burned-area, casualty, or air-quality measurement.

criteria.description: Computes the July 1-August 31 event window as 62 days, image offset ratio 0.855, and forecast offset ratio 0.871.
criteria.name: Event timing and stage offsets
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct window with one offset or inclusive-day error.

criteria.description: Finds hot/dry/windy, extreme fire-weather forecast, and burned-area record signals, and computes 98.1.
criteria.name: Fire-weather signal index
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for the right signals with one missing formula term.

criteria.description: Finds the long plume, cross-Mediterranean smoke, capital-city smoke, and image-stage offset, and computes 97.8.
criteria.name: Smoke-transport index
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for the right smoke signals with one arithmetic or offset error.

criteria.description: Finds Athens homes/cars plus smoke, casualty signal, dozens of fires within 24 hours, and forecast offset, and computes 97.4.
criteria.name: Response-impact index
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for identifying response relevance but missing one report anchor.

criteria.description: Reports direct_damage_reported true, combined_response_priority 97.8, and high_smoke_response_priority.
criteria.name: Classification and damage flag
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct high-priority conclusion with one missing boolean or score.

criteria.description: Bases the assessment on report-supported signals and does not use off-event AOI weather, dNBR, image-change, or gridded precipitation values.
criteria.name: Source discipline
